title: Reported CAG roads/bridges controls and BMC engineer response
publisher: The Indian Express reporting CAG and BMC
locator: Road QMA paragraphs and Chief Engineer’s February 2023 reply
summary: Reports ₹381 crore road payments and delayed quality-monitoring appointment; engineer says departmental sub-engineers supervised and QMA was additional assistance.
limitations: Original audit not retrieved. ₹381 crore is a reported paid amount, not loss or proof that no supervision occurred. QMA absence and absence of all engineering supervision are distinct. No unnamed contractor has been resolved to a named firm.
